# mooncake runs apply

Submit a config to agentd and stream events back

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--config / -c` | string | - | Path to configuration file (default: ./mooncake.yml or ./mooncake/main.yml) |
| `--vars / -v` | []string | - | Path to a variables file. Repeat to layer. |
| `--tags / -t` | string | - | Filter steps by tags (comma-separated) |
| `--base-dir` | string | - | Base directory the daemon should chdir into (default: dirname of --config) |
| `--goal / -g` | string | - | Free-text goal recorded with the run |
| `--system` | bool | false | Use the system-mode agentd socket (/run/mooncake/agentd.sock) |
